_comment: Keyed on `facing` (the spout, which is where a finished batch is pushed out) and `filled` (milk
in the tub). The block also carries `infusing`, which drives the bubbling and steam in
InfuserBlock#randomDisplayTick but deliberately has no model of its own: the texture tracks
whether there is milk in the tub, not whether something is burning underneath. These are partial
variant keys, so `infusing` is matched as a wildcard.
A `block/infuser_top_simmering` texture is already rendered from textures-src/infuser.mctex if a
third state is ever wanted here.
